guide:
You are grading a question-answering benchmark. Judge each item on its own.

For an "answer" item: is the model answer the same answer as any gold answer?
Count it correct when it names the same entity, value or yes/no decision, even
with different wording, extra title words, or a short explanation. Count it
wrong when it is a different entity, hedges between options, says it cannot
answer, or adds a claim that contradicts the gold answer.

For an "evidence" item: list the indexes of the gold sentences whose fact is
stated by the evidence text. A fact is stated when a reader of the evidence
alone would learn it (same entity, same claim, same date or number when the
sentence has one). Be strict: topic overlap or a generic description of the
same subject is not enough. Return an empty list when none.

Write verdicts.json as a JSON array with one object per item, in any order:
{"id": "...", "correct": true}             for answer items
{"id": "...", "supported": [0, 2]}          for evidence items
Use only ids from items.json and do not skip any item.

answers.question: What are some other areas that share a common deer species with the forests of Mara and Mondrem?
gold_answers: New Zealand, Canada, the United States, the Falkland Islands, and Peru.
answers.model_answer: Europe, the Caucasus, Asia Minor, and Iran.

answers.question: In addition to the best known comic servant from Commedia dell'arte, who else is featured in La Surprise de l'amour?
What aspect of the board game Diplomacy is not found in the board game Uncle Wiggily?
answers.model_answer: Negotiation phases for forming and betraying alliances

answers.question: What is Rachelle Amy Beinart's role in the film that follows a group of rebels on a mission?
answers.model_answer: Stunt performer in Rogue One: A Star Wars Story

answers.question: Are the 1908 Ex parte Young and 1948 McCollum v. Board of Education United States Supreme Court cases related to each other in any way?
Do both Adventist World and Girls' Life have a headquarter or editor based in Maryland?
Are both Leycesteria and Anigozanthos native to Australia?
answers.model_answer: No—only Anigozanthos is native to Australia.

answers.question: Both Mulled wine and Blue Lagoon are considered primarily alcoholic or non-alcoholic?
answers.model_answer: Alcoholic (though non-alcoholic mulled wine versions exist)

answers.question: In between The Bears and I and Oceans which was released on July 31, 1974, by Buena Vista Distribution?
The Ronkonkama railroad station and the town of Islip, New York are near?
answers.model_answer: Yes, Ronkonkoma station is in the Town of Islip.

answers.question: What profession is shared by both Monty Banks and George Seaton?
Were Darby O'Gill and the Little People and Dangal only produced by Walt Disney Pictures?
answers.model_answer: No; Dangal was co-produced with Aamir Khan Productions and UTV Motion Pictures.
